Green.description: Seam-friendly fresh pitch, eases with wear — uneven bounce and rough-assisted spin by day 4-5

Dry.description: Mild early, a genuine raging turner for spin by day 4-5

Hard.description: True, neutral surface — stays close to neutral throughout the match

Flat.description: Good batting surface — big first-innings runs, but earned over time

Dead.description: Lifeless surface, offers spin some late assistance over 5 days

note: Regression envelopes follow product expectations, not a newly fitted real-world dataset. Raw reports reside in /tmp/fc-release for this run.
